# FAULTLINE PSALM

[Cold Open]

The exit sign keeps humming.  
I used to call that sound a warning.

[Verse 1]

Two a.m., red on the stairwell sign  
Rain in the wiring, a fault in the line  
Kept my questions in a cardboard box  
Held it shut with a dozen locks

I had a sentence for every scar  
A rule for the dark, a name for the stars  
Then the floor made a sound like a breaking chord  
And I couldn't tell what I'd built it for

[Pre-Chorus]

The organ pipes went out of tune  
Rain came in through the western room  
I couldn't make the trembling stop  
With both my hands upon the lock

[Chorus]

I used to call the lock a shelter  
And the silence holy ground  
Built a chapel out of answers  
With no windows looking out

If there's mercy in the weather  
If there's grace beneath the shock  
Let it find me where I'm standing  
Leave the door unlocked

[Instrumental Drop]

[Verse 2]

On the last train platform, rain in my shoes  
Short on sleep and short on good news  
Check the screen, watch the red numbers slide  
Another late train on the southbound side

I'm good at counting every slight  
Making one bad hour mean a ruined night  
Then a stranger held the door against the wind  
Didn't ask who I was to let me in

[Pre-Chorus 2]

No choir burst above the street  
No miracle beneath my feet  
Just someone waiting through the rain  
For one more person to get in

[Chorus]

I used to call the lock a shelter  
And the silence holy ground  
Built a chapel out of answers  
With no windows looking out

If there's mercy in the weather  
If there's grace beneath the shock  
Let it find me where I'm standing  
Leave the door unlocked

[Breakdown]

All my perfect answers  
Sound like feedback now

Turn it down—  
No. Leave it.

[Bridge]

You didn't split the sky for me  
Or carve a message in the stone  
A stranger held the door against the rain  
And I was not alone

I used to pray for certainty  
As if you owed me proof  
Tonight I have no better words  
Than thank you for the room

[Final Chorus]

I won't call the lock a shelter  
Or the silence holy ground  
There are windows in the chapel  
I can hear the city now

I don't need to stop the weather  
I don't need to stop the clock  
If there's grace in the ordinary  
I'll leave the door unlocked

[Final Hybrid Drop]

Leave the door unlocked  
Leave the door unlocked

[Outro]

Come in.
